docs/index.html.why: `(c || .001)` never runs: c = Math.cos(a) with a = Math.random() * 2π, and cos is 0 only at π/2 and 3π/2, which are not doubles. A scan of 200,001 doubles around each gave no zero (smallest |cos| 6.12e-17). `(s || .001)` on the same line is reachable (Math.sin(0) === 0); the line as a whole is not.

`|| [0, 0]` never runs: hasWall needs /matrix3d/ in the ::after transform, and a computed matrix3d always has 16 values, so the 15-value pattern matches. A spy on getComputedStyle(el, '::after') over all 7 crossings, before and after the import, saw 406 matrix3d values, all 16 long.

dv is a difference of two getBoundingClientRect values, which are always finite: a probe with translateZ from 100px to 1e300px (clamped to 3.40282e38px), with and without perspective, gave only finite rects.

`|| [])[1] || 1` never runs: heroRest reads scale() from a hero part's inline transform. All 16 parts start with `scale(0.2752)` in the markup, and the only script write to them (poseAsm) writes `scale(${sc})` in both branches.

docs/changelog.html.why: The build swaps the language buttons for a link, so the built page has no [data-set-lang] and this callback has nothing to run on. The source page (site/pages/changelog.html, with its buttons) runs it in changelog.spec.mjs.
